theorems.name: Submission.ts_piece_tangent_projection_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ), (∀ i, IsCompact (C i) ∧ (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (F i)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ C i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (F i) w)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (F i)) (C i) ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ C i, ∀ w ∈ C i, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F i v - F i w‖) → ∃ g : Ambient n ℓ → (Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] Ambient n ℓ), StronglyMeasurable g ∧ ∀ i, ∀ w ∈ C i, (∀ j < i, F i w ∉ F j '' C j) → g (F i w) = (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (F i) w).toLinearMap).starProjection
